mart_dim_fiscal_year.doc: The 11 fiscal years in the data, 2015-16 to 2025-26. fy_order runs 1..11; is_latest marks the most recent year.

fiscal_year.doc: Fiscal year as text, e.g. '2024-25' (April 2024 - March 2025). Compare as text.

start_year.doc: Calendar year the fiscal year starts in (2024 for 2024-25).

end_year.doc: Calendar year the fiscal year ends in (2025 for 2024-25).

is_latest.doc: 1 for the most recent fiscal year in the data.

mart_dim_subdivision.grain: one row per sub-division, section or office (the division-wide total is not a row here)
mart_dim_subdivision.doc: Holenarasipura Division's reporting units. is_geographic = 1 for the 5 sub-divisions and the Konanur section (the units whose figures are real places); Division_Office is administrative (all-zero, 2020-21 to 2023-24 only). Saligrama closed after 2017-18.

subdivision_name.doc: Sub-division or section name: Arkalgud, Hangarahalli, Holenarasipura, Ramanathapura, Saligrama (closed after 2017-18), Konanur (a section), Division_Office (administrative).

is_geographic.doc: 1 for sub-divisions and the Konanur section; 0 for Division_Office.

years_with_data.doc: Number of fiscal years with data.

is_active.doc: 1 when the unit still reports in the latest fiscal year.

mart_dim_tariff.grain: one row per (tariff_code, description) slab as printed in the source
mart_dim_tariff.doc: Every tariff slab billed in any year, with its tariff family (LT-1 ... HT-7, MISC for the 61.xxxx / 62.xxxx miscellaneous revenue codes) and voltage class.

tariff_code.doc: Tariff slab code as printed, e.g. 'LT-4(a)', 'HT-2(a)(ii)', '62.9177'.

description.doc: Slab description as printed (source spelling kept, e.g. 'EVM Vheicle Charging Station').

family_code.doc: Tariff family: LT-1 ... LT-7, HT-1 ... HT-7, LT IPP, HT IPP, AUXILIARY CONSUMPTION, or MISC (miscellaneous revenue codes 61.xxxx / 62.xxxx).

voltage_class.doc: 'LT' (low tension, incl. auxiliary consumption), 'HT' (high tension) or 'MISC' (miscellaneous revenue).

family_label.doc: Plain-English meaning of the family, e.g. LT-4 = irrigation pump sets.

is_misc.doc: 1 for miscellaneous revenue codes (fees, penalties, rentals; not consumption billing).

booklet_code.doc: The CESC tariff booklet category (FY2025-26 structure) this slab belongs to, e.g. 'LT-1', 'LT-4(a)', 'HT-2(b)', 'LT-6(b)'. Old codes are mapped to today's category (LT-2(a) domestic -> LT-1, HT-3(a)(i) -> HT-7, HT-3b -> HT-6, LT-7(b) -> LT-3(b)). NULL for IPP, auxiliary consumption and miscellaneous revenue.

booklet_name.doc: The booklet category's name, e.g. 'Domestic', 'Irrigation pump sets up to 10 HP', 'Commercial (HT)'.

mart_dim_tariff_family.doc: Tariff families (LT-1 ... LT-7, HT-1 ... HT-7, LT IPP, HT IPP, AUXILIARY CONSUMPTION, MISC) with a plain-English label and the years each was billed.

family_code.doc: Tariff family: LT-1 ... LT-7, HT-1 ... HT-7, LT IPP, HT IPP, AUXILIARY CONSUMPTION, or MISC (miscellaneous revenue codes 61.xxxx / 62.xxxx).

voltage_class.doc: 'LT' (low tension, incl. auxiliary consumption), 'HT' (high tension) or 'MISC' (miscellaneous revenue).

family_label.doc: Plain-English meaning of the family, e.g. LT-4 = irrigation pump sets.

family_order.doc: Display order of the family (LT first, then HT, then special, then MISC).

mart_fact_booklet_division_year.grain: one row per (fiscal year, tariff booklet category), whole division
mart_fact_booklet_division_year.doc: Division-wide figures per CESC tariff-booklet category (LT-1, LT-2, LT-3(a), LT-3(b), LT-4(a), LT-4(b), LT-4(c), LT-5, LT-6(a), LT-6(b), LT-6(c), LT-7, HT-1, HT-2(a), HT-2(b), HT-2(c)(i), HT-2(c)(ii), HT-3 ... fiscal_year.doc: Fiscal year as text, e.g. '2024-25' (April 2024 - March 2025). Compare as text.

booklet_code.doc: The CESC tariff booklet category (FY2025-26 structure) this slab belongs to, e.g. 'LT-1', 'LT-4(a)', 'HT-2(b)', 'LT-6(b)'. booklet_name.doc: The booklet category's name, e.g. 'Domestic', 'Irrigation pump sets up to 10 HP', 'Commercial (HT)'.

booklet_order.doc: Display order of the booklet category (booklet order: LT-1 first, HT-7 last).

voltage_class.doc: 'LT' (low tension, incl. auxiliary consumption), 'HT' (high tension) or 'MISC' (miscellaneous revenue).

slab_count.doc: Number of tariff slabs summed into this family row.

total_installations.doc: Installations (connections) on the books at year end.

connected_load_hp.doc: Connected load in HP (irrigation pump sets and motive power).

consumption_total.doc: Total energy consumption billed, in units (kWh).

opening_balance_total.doc: Opening balance (arrears brought forward) at the start of the year, in rupees.

demand_revenue_subtotal.doc: Revenue demand (fixed + others + energy; the whole amount for flat-fee misc codes), in rupees.

demand_fac.doc: FPPCA billed: the fuel and power purchase cost adjustment charge (printed as FAC), in rupees. Negative in a year when the adjustment was a refund (2021-22).

demand_pg_surcharge.doc: P&G surcharge billed (2025-26 onward only; empty earlier), in rupees.

demand_total.doc: Total demand (amount billed) for the year, in rupees.

collection_fac_total.doc: FPPCA (FAC) collected, in rupees (cash / cheque plus adjustments).

collection_pg_surcharge_total.doc: P&G surcharge collected (2025-26 onward), in rupees.

collection_grand_total.doc: Total collection for the year (cash, cheque and adjustments), in rupees.

closing_balance_total.doc: Closing balance (arrears outstanding) at year end = opening balance + demand - collection, in rupees. A position: never add it up over years.

security_deposit_held.doc: Security deposit held at year end, in rupees.

dc_installations.doc: DC installations as printed in their own column (2018-19 onwards; NULL before, when the sheet printed DC and MNR together -- use dc_mnr_installations for a series across all years). DC stands for direct connection (confirmed by CESC): when a meter burns out or is faulty and no replacement of the required capacity is in stock, supply is given on a direct connection basis without a meter; under KERC rules a new meter is to be installed within 3 days, and consumption in the unmetered gap is billed pro-rata on the previous month's consumption.

mnr_installations.doc: MNR (meter not recording) installations, printed separately from 2018-19 (NULL before; earlier years only have the combined dc_mnr_installations). Their consumption is billed on an assessed basis (see consumption_assessed).

ob_fac.doc: FPPCA (fuel and power purchase cost adjustment, printed as FAC) outstanding at the start of the year, in rupees.

closing_balance_fac.doc: FPPCA (FAC) still outstanding at the end of the year, in rupees (part of closing_balance_total).

dc_mnr_installations.doc: DC plus MNR (meter not recording) installations, comparable across all years: the single combined column printed up to 2017-18, and the separate DC and MNR columns added together from 2018-19. DC stands for direct connection (confirmed by CESC): when a meter burns out or is faulty and no replacement of the required capacity is in stock, supply is given on a direct connection basis without a meter; under KERC rules a new meter is to be installed within 3 days, and consumption in the unmetered gap is billed pro-rata on the previous month's consumption.

dc_column_installations.doc: The sheet's own 'DC' column: the combined DC/MNR column up to 2017-18, the DC column alone from 2018-19. It is what the sheet's printed '% of DC/MNR' divides by total installations. DC stands for direct connection (confirmed by CESC): supply given without a meter while a faulty meter awaits replacement.

uncollected_demand.doc: Demand minus collection for the year, in rupees: the year's own billed-but-not-collected amount (negative when more was collected than billed, e.g. against old arrears).

collection_cash_total.doc: Collection received as cheque / cash ('Chq/cash' columns, all heads), in rupees. Cash + adjustment = collection_grand_total.

collection_adjust_total.doc: Collection booked as adjustments ('Adjust' columns, all heads), in rupees: the Government subsidy (confirmed by CESC). Almost all of it is LT-1 domestic (Gruha Jyothi, from August 2023) and LT-4(a) irrigation pump sets (the tariff booklet: GoK pays their tariff); other categories carry small amounts, sometimes negative (reversals).

collection_efficiency_pct.doc: Collection efficiency = collection_grand_total / demand_total x 100 for this row. For several rows recompute SUM(collection_grand_total) * 100.0 / SUM(demand_total); never AVG this column. Can exceed 100 when old arrears are collected.

live_installation_pct.doc: Live installations as a % of total installations for this row.

arrears_to_demand_ratio.doc: Closing balance / demand for this row (how many years' billing is outstanding).

demand_per_unit_rs.doc: Demand per unit of consumption (average billed rate) = demand_total / consumption_total, in rupees per unit.

demand_per_installation_rs.doc: Average demand per installation = demand_total / total_installations, in rupees.

billed_installation_pct.doc: Installations actually billed as a % of total installations (the sheet's '% of billed installations'). Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

dc_mnr_installation_pct.doc: The sheet's '% of DC/MNR': the DC column as a % of total installations (up to 2017-18 the combined DC/MNR column; from 2018-19 the DC column alone, MNR not included -- see mnr_installation_pct). Reproduces the printed figure on every grand-total row. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

mnr_installation_pct.doc: MNR (meter not recording) installations as a % of total installations, 2018-19 onwards. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

metered_consumption_pct.doc: Metered consumption as a % of total consumption (the sheet's '% of metered consumption'). Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

assessed_consumption_pct.doc: Assessed (estimated, not read from a meter) consumption as a % of total consumption (the sheet's '% of assessed consumption'). Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

fac_share_of_demand_pct.doc: FPPCA (FAC) billed as a % of total demand. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

fac_collection_efficiency_pct.doc: FPPCA (FAC) collected as a % of FPPCA billed. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

fac_per_unit_rs.doc: FPPCA (FAC) billed per unit of energy consumed, in rupees per unit. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

collection_per_installation_rs.doc: Average collection per installation (consumer) = collection_grand_total / total_installations. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

arrears_per_installation_rs.doc: Average closing balance (arrears) per installation (consumer) = closing_balance_total / total_installations. Recompute from sums for several rows; never AVG or SUM this column.

collection_efficiency_without_adj_pct.doc: Collection efficiency without adjustments = cash / cheque collection / demand x 100 -- the formula in the sheet's own header '% of Collection Efficiency without Adjustment (34-Adj./30)'. The percentage the sheet prints in that column is inconsistent (KI-14), so this is recomputed from the printed amounts. Recompute from sums for several rows.

adjustment_share_pct.doc: Subsidy share of the collection = collection_adjust_total / collection_grand_total x 100 (the adjustment is the Government subsidy). Recompute from sums for several rows.

billing_efficiency_pct.doc: Billing efficiency as the sheet's consolidation block defines it, 'Billing Efficiency (4/3)' = installations actually billed / live installations x 100. Recompute from sums for several rows.

atc_loss_pct.doc: AT&C (aggregate technical & commercial) loss = 100 - billing efficiency x collection efficiency (the standard formula), with the sheet's own billing efficiency (installations billed / live) and collection efficiency (collection / demand). The data has no energy-input (units purchased / received) figures, so the energy-based technical loss is not part of it; negative when more is collected than billed (arrears recovery). Recompute from sums for several rows.

energy_charge_per_unit_paise.doc: Energy charges billed per unit = demand_energy_charges / consumption_total x 100, in paise per kWh -- comparable with the tariff booklet's energy rate. Recompute from sums for several rows.

known_issues.detail: Under the restructured tariff (in force in the 2024-25 sheet, and printed in the CESC tariff booklet FY2025-26 to FY2027-28, KERC order 27.03.2025) LT-1 is the whole domestic category: Bhagyajyothi / Kutirajyothi plus all residential lighting & heating, which the sheets up to 2023-24 printed as LT-2(a). LT-2 now means private educational institutions and hospitals only. The 2024-25 and 2025-26 sheets print the domestic slabs under code LT-1 (marked source_note 'LT-1 A'); 2024-25 prints LT-1 and LT-1 A as two subtotals with no combined row. Family figures (as printed) are therefore not comparable across 2023-24 / 2024-25 for LT-1 and LT-2; the booklet-category tables (mart_fact_booklet_*) map LT-2(a) to LT-1 in every year, so 'domestic (LT-1)' is comparable across all 11 years there. The same restructuring moved Government lift irrigation HT-3(a)(i) to HT-7 and hoardings LT-7(b) to LT-3(b); HT-3b became HT-6.
known_issues.caveat: From 2024-25 the tariff restructuring (CESC tariff booklet) puts all domestic supply under LT-1 (it was LT-2(a) before), so LT-1 and LT-2 as printed are not comparable with earlier years; the booklet-category figures (domestic LT-1) are.

known_issues.title: Division total exceeds the sum of sub-divisions from 2019-20 (miscellaneous revenue)
known_issues.detail: Re-verified from the raw workbook (2026-10-01). Division GRAND TOTAL demand minus the sum of its sub-divisions' and section's GRAND TOTALs: 0 for 2015-16 to 2018-19; 2019-20 +0.503% (8,038,527); 2020-21 +0.003%; 2021-22 +0.010%; 2022-23 +0.575%; 2023-24 +1.065%; 2024-25 +3.475% (102,725,031, i.e. Rs 10.27 crore); 2025-26 +0.206%. The whole gap is miscellaneous revenue booked only in the division's own block (mainly 62.9177 'other recoveries', also 62.9327, 62.9017, 62.9027, 62.9097): LT and HT categories and installations agree to the rupee (installations except 2015-16, KI-12). Collection shows the same gap except 2025-26, where the division's collection equals the sum of its units and only demand differs.
known_issues.caveat: The division's own total includes some miscellaneous revenue booked only at division level, so it is higher than the sum of its sub-divisions (by up to 3.5%, in 2024-25).

known_issues.title: Saligrama closed after 2017-18
known_issues.detail: Saligrama sub-division reports 2015-16 to 2017-18 only. In 2017-18 its demand is 0 while collections continued against old arrears.
known_issues.caveat: Saligrama sub-division closed after 2017-18, so it has no figures after that year.

known_issues.title: Division_Office is administrative
known_issues.detail: Division_Office appears only 2020-21 to 2023-24 as an administrative unit with no consumer installations. Its figures are zero except 2020-21, where it carries 2,410 of miscellaneous revenue (61.9067, other receipts) -- re-verified from the raw workbook. It is excluded from the sub-division facts.

known_issues.title: Printed 'Sub Total of LT-5' is the LT-5(a) subtotal (0) up to 2023-24
known_issues.detail: Re-verified from the raw workbook (2026-10-01). Up to 2023-24 the LT-5 family is printed in two blocks: LT-5(a) (areas under BMA / municipal limits) and LT-5(b) (all other areas). The row printed 'Sub Total of LT-5' closes the LT-5(a) block -- it is the LT-5(a) subtotal, mislabelled -- and LT-5(a) had no installations and no demand in any block in any of those years, so it reads 0. The family total is 'Sub Total of LT-5 (a+b)' (= 'Sub Total of LT-5 b'), which equals every LT-5 line item and the mart's LT-5 in every block and year. From 2024-25 LT-5 is one block (the sub-division blocks label its subtotal 'Sub Total of LT-5 b'). Holenarasipura 2015-16 prints its LT-5(a) rows with the code 'LT-5(b)' (all zero, no effect on any figure).

known_issues.title: Miscellaneous revenue codes are flat fees
known_issues.detail: 61.xxxx / 62.xxxx codes are fees, penalties, rentals and receipts, not consumption billing: their Fixed/Energy split is zero and the whole amount sits in revenue demand.
known_issues.caveat: Miscellaneous revenue (61.xxxx / 62.xxxx codes) is fees and receipts, not consumption billing.

known_issues.title: P&G surcharge only from 2025-26
known_issues.detail: The P&G surcharge columns exist only from 2025-26; empty in earlier years is correct.

known_issues.title: Printed FAC collection slightly below its line items, 2015-16 to 2017-18
known_issues.detail: The division's printed FAC collection is up to 0.132% below the sum of its own line items in 2015-16 to 2017-18. Division figures here use the printed total.

known_issues.title: Collection efficiency can exceed 100%
known_issues.detail: Collection includes payments against arrears from earlier years, so a year's collection can exceed its demand (e.g. Konanur 2016-17, 119.88%).

known_issues.title: Source spellings kept in slab descriptions
known_issues.detail: Descriptions keep the sheet's own spelling ('EVM Vheicle Charging Station', 'Univercity'); the router matches common variants.

known_issues.title: One printed grand total leaves total consumption blank
known_issues.detail: Holenarasipura's 2023-24 GRAND TOTAL row prints metered (39,590,136) and assessed (87,991,965) consumption but leaves the total blank; the per-unit and percentage columns of that row are blank too. The mart takes the total as metered + assessed (127,582,101), which equals the sum of its line items.

known_issues.title: 2015-16 division installations exceed the sub-divisions by 98
known_issues.detail: In 2015-16 the division's printed grand total shows 159,149 installations while its sub-divisions and section add up to 159,051 (98 fewer). Every later year agrees exactly. Division figures use the division's own printed total.

known_issues.title: FPPCA was a refund in 2021-22
known_issues.detail: The FPPCA (printed as FAC) billed is negative in 2021-22 (division -24,371,573.88; collection -22,083,969.12): the adjustment was passed back to consumers that year. Shares and rates for that year are therefore negative.
known_issues.caveat: FPPCA (FAC) was a refund in 2021-22, so that year's FPPCA figures are negative.

known_issues.title: Collection efficiency without adjustment: shown by the sheet's own header formula
known_issues.detail: The sheet's column header defines it as (34 - Adj.) / 30, i.e. cash / cheque collection / demand; the app shows exactly that (collection_efficiency_without_adj_pct), computed from the printed cash and adjustment amounts. The percentage the sheet itself prints in that column does not follow one rule (tested on all 68 grand-total rows: cash / demand in 2015-16, 2019-20, 2020-21, 2022-23; cash plus the tax adjustment in 2016-17, 2023-24, 2024-25; neither in 2025-26), so it is not used. Every other printed percentage reproduces exactly (build check).
known_issues.caveat: Collection efficiency without adjustment is computed by the sheet's header formula (cash collection / demand); the percentage printed in that column of the sheet is inconsistent across years.

known_issues.title: 'DC' stands for direct connection (confirmed by CESC)
known_issues.detail: CESC confirmed (2026-10-01) that DC in the DCB statement means direct connection: when a meter burns out or is faulty and no replacement of the required capacity is in stock, supply is given on a direct connection basis without a meter. Under KERC rules a new meter is to be installed within 3 days, and consumption in the gap is billed pro-rata on the previous month's consumption. The sheet's 'DC installations' column is about 39,000 of 184,000 installations in 2025-26. The sheet's '% of DC/MNR' is the DC column alone over total installations (MNR not included from 2018-19).

known_issues.title: DC and MNR are printed separately only from 2018-19
known_issues.detail: Up to 2017-18 the sheet prints one combined DC/MNR column; from 2018-19 two columns. Separate DC or MNR figures exist from 2018-19 only; the combined figure is comparable across all years.
known_issues.caveat: DC and MNR are printed separately only from 2018-19; earlier years have one combined DC/MNR figure.

known_issues.title: Miscellaneous revenue lines: the 'Adjust' column is not part of their collection
known_issues.detail: On the 61.xxxx / 62.xxxx miscellaneous revenue lines the sheet sometimes fills the 'Adjust' (and in a few lines the 'Chq/cash') column without carrying it into the printed collection total (e.g. Division 2021-22 '62.9177 Misc., Recoveries' adjust 14.5 lakh, total 450). Their printed collection total is used, counted wholly as cash; on the printed grand totals the printed misc subtotal is used the same way. With that, cash + adjustment = printed collection on every row (build check).

known_issues.title: Adjustment collections are the Government subsidy (confirmed by CESC)
known_issues.detail: Collections are printed as 'Chq/cash' and 'Adjust'. CESC confirmed (2026-10-01) that the adjustment is the Government subsidy. Almost all of it is LT-1 domestic (Gruha Jyothi from August 2023: the adjusted share of domestic collection was 16-31% up to 2022-23, 60% in 2023-24 and 82-84% in 2024-25 / 2025-26) and LT-4(a) irrigation pump sets up to 10 HP (collected 100% by adjustment; the tariff booklet: GoK pays their Commission Determined Tariff). Other categories carry small amounts, sometimes negative (reversals of earlier adjustments).

known_issues.title: AT&C loss uses the sheet's billing efficiency (no energy input in the data)
known_issues.detail: AT&C loss = 100 - billing efficiency x collection efficiency. The official MoP / PFC formula uses an energy-based billing efficiency (units billed / units input); the DCB workbook has no energy-input (units purchased / received at the sub-station) figures anywhere, so the app uses the billing efficiency the sheet's own consolidation block prints, 'Billing Efficiency (4/3)' = installations billed / live installations, with collection efficiency = collection / demand. It is negative in years when more was collected than billed (arrears recovered). Adding feeder / sub-station energy input would turn it into the full energy-based AT&C.
known_issues.caveat: AT&C loss here = 100 - billing efficiency x collection efficiency, using the sheet's billing efficiency (installations billed / live); the data has no energy-input figures, so energy (technical) loss is not included.

known_issues.title: LT-5(b), Free Lighting (FL) and Office Lighting (OL) lines, placed by the tariff booklet
known_issues.detail: The DCB sheets print some lines the tariff booklet does not name separately; the booklet places each in its category. LT-5(b) 'Heating & Motive Power - other than BMA' is LT-5 Industrial: The booklet has only LT-5, with no sub-categories (no (a) / (b)); up to 2023-24 all of this division's LT-5 is printed as LT-5(b) (LT-5(a) has no installations here), and from 2024-25 LT-5 and LT-5(b) are billed at the same rate (464 paise in 2025-26). '(OL) Office Lighting' lines under LT-3 are LT-3(a) Commercial ('all offices'): 13-15 installations at the LT-3 rate, paid 99-100% by adjustment (subsidy) every year. '(FL) Free Lighting' lines (LT-2(a) up to 2023-24, LT-1 from 2024-25) are LT-1 Domestic: 1-8 installations at the domestic rate, 85-95% paid by adjustment even before Gruha Jyothi.

rules: Division-wide figures come from mart_fact_division_year (or mart_fact_family_division_year / mart_fact_slab_division_year). Never add the sub-division tables up to get a division figure: from 2019-20 the division books some miscellaneous revenue that no sub-division carries.
Ratio columns (*_pct, *_ratio, *_per_unit_rs, *_per_installation_rs) are for one row. Over several rows recompute from sums, e.g. SUM(collection_grand_total) * 100.0 / SUM(demand_total).
Stock columns (installations, connected load, opening / closing balance, security deposit) are positions at year end: add them across places in ONE year, never across years.
Family questions ('LT-4 demand', 'HT-2 collection') read the family tables; slab questions (one tariff_code or description) read the slab tables.

Tariff sub-category questions as the CESC tariff booklet names them (LT-4(a), LT-3(b), HT-2(b), HT-2(c)(i), LT-6(b) ...) read mart_fact_booklet_division_year / mart_fact_booklet_subdivision_year (booklet_code); tariff rates and rules read mart_tariff_booklet_rate / mart_tariff_booklet_rule.
A family or sub-division missing for a year means it was not billed / did not exist that year: say so, never report 0.
